name: Static Veil
flavour: Thoughts crackle before they land.

name: Sighted Pelt
flavour: The eyes sewn on it never blink.
note: Huge accuracy, evasion and life. The projectile damage per 200 accuracy is simplified to a flat 8% increased projectile attack damage.
drop: Projectile Attack Damage per 200 Accuracy Rating

name: Frostbound Cage
flavour: Cold looks back through the bars.
note: Socketed gems supported by concentrated effect (dense blast analog), cold damage, mana and heavy energy shield at a slower recharge. Dropped the cold damage over time multiplier (variant line).

name: Monsoon Bascinet
flavour: The sky opens, and so do you.
note: Socketed melee physical and faster attack supports, added physical to attacks, big life, armour and evasion, block with a chance of an endurance charge (grit analog) on block. Dropped the Blind support and the no-chest-armour restriction.
drop: chance to gain an Endurance Charge when you Block

name: Shattered Coronet
flavour: Worn by someone who had nothing left to lose.
note: More damage on low life, attributes, armour and energy shield, chaos resistance, less mana regeneration. Dropped the socketed Cast on Death support.

name: Ravenous Circlet
flavour: Hunger turned inward, and found a use.
note: +1 to socketed gems with reduced reservation, heavy energy shield and the mana-bastion keystone. Dropped the triggered corpse skill, the chance to start energy shield recharge on skill use and the focussed ailment duration (crafted variant).
drop: Energy Shield Recharge to start when you use a Skill
Duration of Ailments you inflict while Focussed

name: Thunderbound Mask
flavour: Knotted tight enough to hold weather.

name: Sparkguile Circlet
flavour: A sleight of hand that ends in lightning.

drop: Curse non-Cursed Enemies with a random Curse

name: Cinder Cleaver
flavour: Light enough to swing all day.

flavour: Silver on one edge, storm on the other.

flavour: Everything it freezes it also pockets.
note: Strong physical gavel with cold attack damage; killing a frozen enemy triggers a cold nova (Ice Nova stands in for the reference triggered burst). Dropped the item rarity from frozen enemies.

Icicle Burst when you Kill a Frozen Enemy

increased Effect of Buffs on you

flavour: Once in hand, it stays in hand.
note: Physical sword with multistrike support and stun avoidance, at the cost of longer stuns when they do land.

name: Stormwake Blade
flavour: Each swing leaves a ripple in the air.
note: Spell damage, physical damage and added lightning on a sword; attacking triggers a lightning storm (Storm Call stands in for the reference triggered skill). Dropped the summoned harbinger (minion).

name: Winterbreath Quiver
flavour: Each arrow leaves a little frost in the throat.

name: Clockwork Quiver
flavour: Wound tight, released twice.

flavour: Red edge, blue edge, one spin.
note: Added fire and cold damage to spells and attacks with strength, dexterity and fire and cold resistances. Dropped the summoned harbinger (minion).

note: Added cold to attacks, energy shield, cold resistance, projectile speed and mana on kill. The void charge system is replaced by a bow trigger every 2.5 seconds (Ice Shot stands in for the reference triggered skill).

flavour: A coal that does not go out.
note: Fire resistance twice, strength and added fire damage; more fire resistance under the fire herald.

flavour: It remembers a sweeter decay.
note: Chaos resistance twice, attributes and added chaos damage; more chaos resistance under the agony herald.

name: Spark Signet
flavour: Every touch stings a little.
note: Lightning resistance twice, intelligence and added lightning damage; more lightning resistance under the thunder herald.
